steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: No, don't... don't take them away...
Eve, trembling with pain all over, curls up in her wheelchair. The sharp spikes of the shackles did not directly harm her, but the burden of another force made her fall into a coma.
A sinister black aura surrounds Eve, whispering chaotic murmurs that outsiders can't understand. It repeatedly tempts the girl in the wheelchair, dragging her deeper into the nightmare.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Bone, Bone... we haven't... lit the birthday candles yet...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Why did you all leave again... You all left...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: It's the grey rag doll that snatched you away!

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I won't lose to him... I won't let him destroy our home again... Hurry up and turn into a quiet toy.
steps.female_content: I won't lose to her... I won't let her destroy our home again... Hurry up and turn into a quiet toy.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: No one will disturb us. We'll be just like before...
Eve opens her eyes, but there's no light in her pupils. Her consciousness is still wandering in nothingness, unaware of the long shadows cast by the two toys beside her.
I've brought Eve back. She's tired.
Yes... let's... do something for her...
The two toys look at the half-asleep Eve, sigh softly, and retreat outside the door.
With a "clack," they lock Eve inside the room.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Cough, cough, cough!
You've managed to save your arm, but more and more cotton is spewing out from your body. You try to stuff it back in vain. The toyification is still going.
This is what one has to go through to become a toy. Pepper spent more than a day here alone, enduring all this... Fortunately, your link with her is still there. There's still a chance.

steps.speaker: Bone
steps.content: Woof, woof...

steps.speaker: Bone
steps.content: Woof...
Before your eyes, the defeated puppy lies in the dust, repeating its monotonous barks.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Is it really a puppy? Why does it keep repeating...

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: It was the same with the screaming chicken and that ball.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Is this also Eve's personal hobby?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Or perhaps it's some kind of obsession, an emotion so strong that it can't be let go, even when turned into a toy...
You tentatively move closer to the tinplate dog on the ground. Seeing that it truly lost consciousness and is no longer resisting, you place your hand on it.
The red spikes penetrate the tinplate, spreading inside this shell to explore.
But where the shackles pass... you don't feel anything.
Under the tinplate, there's a hollow void.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Did you discover anything?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No... it's just a toy dog. There are no signs of life inside its body.

But you clearly remember, when you used the shackles to probe the wooden sheep that Pepper turned into, you could clearly feel Pepper's presence inside the wooden body. Are they different from Pepper? Different...
You want to lean in again to feel the puppy, but Oliver pulls you back.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: You'd rather touch the puppy again than care about Oliver?

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Listen, there's a terrifying noise and it's getting closer, right behind Oliver...

Your senses are becoming more numb. You withdraw the hand reaching out to the tinplate puppy. With Oliver's guidance, you hear the approaching frail and unfamiliar female voice, accompanied by blurred, echoing sighs.
Found you.
Go. Go. Go.
Help Eve.
